notes: Entirely business-type entity (City of Wahoo Combined Municipal Utilities Fund, calendar year ended 12/31/2025); governmental fields null. Statement of Revenues and Expenses (p2) used for receipts/disbursements: operating revenues + interest income as receipts; operating expenses by group (Production, Distribution/Collection, General & Administrative) plus interest expense as disbursements; 'Contributions in Aid of Construction' and 'Transfers to City' are '-' (zero) so omitted. Source rows printed 2025 column only (2024 restated column ignored). Net position beginning = restated 2024 ending 23,818,945 (p1); identity 23,818,945 + 11,844,818 - 11,276,605 = 24,387,158. Receipts/disbursements totals are computed (no single total printed). Proprietary cash-flow figures from p3 (the 'Financing Activities' subtotal at 122,290 under investing is labelled as such; it is the investing section). Balance sheet from p1 Statement of Net Position; 'Less: Current Maturities' (-290,039) entered as a negative so liabilities tie to 7,195,552; Deferred Lease Arrangement Receipts is the deferred inflow (category other liabilities placeholder). Detail: combining schedule by department for 2025 (p5: Electric, Water, Sewer, Gas) recorded once; the separate department pages (pp7-10, same 2025 figures with prior year) and the 2024 restated combining page (p6) are not double counted. Detail totals computed because only operating totals are printed; nonoperating interest income/expense lines are included in detail. Zero ('-') lines skipped. Proprietary operating cash flow ties to the cash flow reconciliation on p4 (1,628,216; gained in v8 re-trim, no new data). Read pages 1-10 of 10
